propositions: Removal records for managed links lacking peer confirmation are incorrectly applied because `managed_refs` is monotonic and cannot distinguish never-pushed local links from peer-deleted ones

When an outbound ADD is deduped by an inward same-vendor-type remote link in opposite direction, the local link is never pushed and not G4-protected, allowing its removal record to reach the applier and delete it
_inbound_unlink_one must consult the peer confirmation store before removing a link; if not confirmed it should decline, log a warning, and return False without writing an UNLINK event
The confirmation store must be opened once per pass in _inbound_update_apply_links and threaded into _inbound_unlink_one to avoid repeated opens
A None store (unopenable) must disable the check and restore current behavior without requiring the confirmation store as a precondition
The per-pass decline count must be reported in the _inbound_update_apply_links INFO summary alongside impossible-link skips for operator visibility
